(2004) supplies the general backwards-chain local-spectral method. The new contribution is explicit all-positive-null-tail, all-p coefficient core classification combined with a sharp iff cross-operator inclusion criterion and the universal H0 invariant. Comparison is by implication, with a residual risk of differently worded older statements.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of two canonical structural subspaces over a large family that includes a new counterexample. The invariance of one core versus precise variability of the other yields a nontrivial inclusion poset with exact weight criterion; it is useful for comparing operators invisible to H0 and not a mere parameter renaming.
